answer: Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the river is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
